messages:
Priya: Heads-up: this morning ~09:17 PT a batch of webinar signups hit HubSpot but owners stayed null. Saw it on the SLA dashboard.
Connor: Saw a dip in claimed leads for the 09:10-09:25 window. Any recent workflow changes?
Ria: We merged the enrichment change last night that adds `topic_hint`. I think the RR condition checks on `lead_category` and a hashed key that might not exist yet during initial create.
Priya: Can we put a short-lived mitigation so Sales doesn't miss follow-ups?
DevOpsBot: alert: hubspot.webhook.retry_count exceeded for endpoint /api/assign at 2026-03-17T09:18:34Z (status 429).
Connor: Quick mitigation proposal: set temporary HubSpot workflow to auto-assign webinar leads to "SDR Intake" for 20 minutes. Also queue a backfill for unassigned leads in that window.
Ria: I can flip the workflow and run a one-off backfill. Backfill snippet: 
```
# backfill command
scripts/run_backfill --filter "source:webinar AND owner:null" --assign team:sdri
```
Priya: Do it. Also, add a telemetry flag in payload when we do auto-assign so we can filter those leads in analytics.
Ria: Done on the workflow change. Running backfill now. 87 leads matched, starting assignment job.
Connor: For root cause: two options discussed - 1) evaluate round-robin after enrichment completes, 2) keep current eval + short delayed re-check (e.g., 7s) when owner is null.
Priya: Option 2 is faster to ship as a hotfix; Option 1 is preferred cleaner fix for next sprint. Can we do both? Hotfix today, long-term in planning.
Ria: I'll deploy a delayed re-check job (7s) which re-applies RR only if owner still null and mark leads that hit the re-check. Adding a guard to prevent double-assign.
DevOpsBot: deploy.start by Ria at 09:41:02Z (canary)
DevOpsBot: deploy.success canary at 09:41:10Z
Ria: Backfill completed: 87 leads assigned, zero conflicts. Marked all with tag "auto-assigned-temp".
Connor: Monitoring shows claim rate back to baseline. I'll update the runbook with steps and who to page.
Priya: Please open an RFC for moving RR to after-enrichment with rollout plan, SFDC mapping checks, and a rollback step. Include test cases for payloads missing `topic_hint`.
Ria: RFC created and linked in the ticket: RFC-2026-042. I pasted the pseudo-change in the ticket: 
```
# pseudo-change
on after_enrichment_event:
  if lead.owner == null:
    assign_round_robin(pool='sdr-webinar', metadata={'via':'post-enrich'})
```
SalesOps: Noted. We'll inform SDR leads about the temporary auto-assign so they know why some records have the "auto-assigned-temp" tag.
Priya: TL;DR: temporary workflow assigned webinar leads to SDR Intake for 20m, backfilled 87 leads, deployed 7s delayed re-eval hotfix, RFC for post-enrichment RR in backlog. Will follow up with analytics on how many leads needed the re-check.
Connor: Thanks team. I'll track metrics and add an alert if delayed re-check rate >1% in future. :thumbsup:
Ria: Leaving a note in HubSpot workflow history about the change and why.
Priya: Closing the loop once RFC lands and we verify SF mappings. Good catch, everyone. :rocket:
